title: Deeper/broader PAR-139 matrix semantics and clip-state reconciliation
mode: Primary-source documentation and open-source source/issue review plus local plan reconciliation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reconcile group-71 semantics across the ODA DWG specification, Autodesk DXF/API documentation, and ezdxf source/docs.
Review independent open-source SPATIAL_FILTER support and reported matrix/XCLIP failure modes in ACadSharp, LibreDWG, ezdxf, and IxMilia.Dxf.
Tighten PAR-139 acceptance so exact field persistence is distinguished from affine transform and native clipping semantics.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §20.4.94 SPATIAL_FILTER
sources.observed: The DWG body calls group 71 Dispbound/display boundary and defines the first and second 12-value matrices as inverse block transformation and clip-boundary transformation, each a 4x3 column-major array. This is authoritative for DWG byte layout, not evidence of application rendering semantics.

sources.name: Autodesk SPATIAL_FILTER DXF table, managed Enabled property, and Clip Blocks and Xrefs guide
sources.observed: The DXF table describes group 71 as clip-boundary display-enabled. The managed Enabled property describes making the clip volume effective or making it all of 3D space; the .NET clipping guide says the property shows or hides the boundary. These official descriptions conflict or are not sufficiently precise to collapse presentation and clipping-effect semantics.

sources.name: ezdxf 1.4.5 XClip docs and current source
sources.observed: Source maps group 71 to is_clipping_enabled, treats matrices as Matrix44 values, and uses the final 24 group-40 values. Documentation limits XClip to 2D paths and says inverted structure is not fully understood; current issue #1305 reports WCS clipping-path coordinates differing from a CAD application's display. The issue is an unresolved report, not a local reproduction.

sources.name: ACadSharp open pull requests #1230 and #1226
sources.observed: Open, unmerged PR #1230's author reports a DXF matrix-selection defect and DWG/DXF matrix convention mismatch, and says identity matrices masked the test gap. Open PR #1226 reports a downstream XCLIP bounding-box defect and translation lost when applying file-order matrices as that project's Matrix4 convention. These are undeployed author reports and test-design warnings, not verified current ACadSharp behavior or proof of a libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: LibreDWG typed SPATIAL_FILTER declaration and object manual
sources.observed: LibreDWG declares SPATIAL_FILTER stable and documents typed boundary points, normal/origin, group 71-73 fields, and both matrix arrays. This makes it a candidate pinned structural DWG comparator, not a rendering oracle or universal support guarantee.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf open issue listing and release history
sources.observed: The issue listing shows #100, 'SpatialFilter for xref doesnt work', as open, but the issue body could not be fetched in this pass. The changelog separately records a front-clipping-plane handling fix. The issue title is only a low-confidence risk signal.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw code and PAR-139.5 test audit
localReferences: src/drw_objects.cpp:16295-16362 (DWG SPATIAL_FILTER encoder writes two 12-value matrices in stored order)
src/drw_objects.cpp:19198-19354 (DXF group-code parsing and typed field validation)
src/drw_objects.cpp:19375-19520 (DWG parser reads and stores both matrices in wire order)
src/libdxfrw.cpp:23217-23307 (DXF writer emits stored matrix arrays in order)
tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp:7480-8000 (generated SPATIAL_FILTER graph roundtrip controls; matrix values are distinct sequential sentinels)
sources.observed: The current codec preserves vectors and does not apply them as matrices. PAR-139.5 checks exact array retention/order using sequential sentinel values; those tests establish field persistence, not a valid affine mapping, matrix-role interpretation, or rendered clip behavior.

assessment.planImpact: PAR-139 now treats group 71's semantic label as provisional because official documentation and peer terminology conflict; it requires separate observation of clipping effect, frame display, and plotting. PAR-139.5 is limited to exact field persistence because its matrices are sequential sentinels. PAR-139.6 now requires affine non-identity matrices, independently derived point mappings, and a cross-format check when an independently generated DWG witness exists. ACadSharp PR reports are used only as test-design warnings; LibreDWG and ezdxf remain pinned, profile-specific secondary comparators.

method.kind: Primary-source documentation/source review, current open-source issue/PR review, local source/test inspection, and plan editing
method.limitations: ACadSharp PRs are open and unmerged; their descriptions are author reports. ezdxf #1305 is unresolved. IxMilia issue #100's body could not be fetched. Mutable peer master sources were not pinned or executed. Autodesk's documentation does not resolve the group-71 semantic conflict. No claim about actual clip rendering, inversion, or native acceptance is made.
